title: Editorial Policy: Independence, Corrections and Disclosures
description: LegalCostGuides editorial standards: independence from advertisers, how commercial content is labeled, corrections, AI use and what we will not publish.
body:
Independence

Figures and explanations are chosen on accuracy and usefulness alone. Advertisers, LawDepot and the sale of our own planning kits have no say in what a page says about costs. We do not accept paid placements, sponsored articles or payments from law firms or referral networks.

How commercial content is labeled

  • Ads are served by Google AdSense and are visually separate from the content.
  • Affiliate links (LawDepot) appear in boxes labeled "Affiliate", carry rel="sponsored", and include a disclosure next to the link.
  • Our own products appear in boxes labeled "Our planning kit" with the price. We place them only on pages where they fit the reader's task, and never on legal aid, contact or policy pages.

Accuracy and sourcing

Every figure is cited to its source or shown as a labeled example. See how we research. Content is written for U.S. readers and is general information, not legal advice.

Use of AI tools

We use AI tools to help draft, check and format pages and to build our planning kits. Every factual claim is checked against the cited source before publication, and a human (Javi Pérez) is responsible for everything published.

Corrections

Email javiperezguides@gmail.com with the page, the statement and a source. Verified corrections are made promptly and reflected in the page's review date.
